root_idea.summary: The root centers on hesitation, fluctuation, or going back and forth in a matter.
root_idea.development: This orientation extends to mental perplexity and loss of direction, water that circles or remains without an outlet, and fullness in which contents move within a container.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested nominal is presented under the normalized citation form حَيْرَان.

senses.definition: Confused or perplexed, unable to discern the right course; erring or lost in direction.
senses.usage_conditions: Describes a state of mental bewilderment and uncertainty, especially in an affair or situation where the right course cannot be recognized.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be dazzled by something looked at, turning one's eyes away from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Identified as the primary signification of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water: to collect and remain, circle, or fluctuate in a place as though it had no way to run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A description of water moving back and forth or remaining confined in one place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to become confused or perplexed and unable to discern the right course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction corresponding to the state of bewilderment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of water, reportedly to whirl in an eddy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attribution is qualified in the lexical evidence, which notes that this sense may properly require the passive form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause food or a drink to descend easily through the throat into the stomach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use describing easy passage of food or drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain or become stationary or without direction; of clouds, to continue without motion while pouring rain, and of time, people, or a person staying in a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction is applied to clouds, time, a person, or remaining at a place; the contexts emphasize continuation without proceeding in a clear direction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a place or land, to become full of water; of a bowl, to become full of food and grease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fullness construction applied to water-filled land or to a container filled with food or grease.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of youthful sap or vigor: to flow, become complete, and fill or occupy the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative bodily use; the lexical reports vary between flowing, becoming complete, and filling the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a beverage or wine, to be made to descend easily through the throat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in a passive construction describing the drink's easy passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enclosure like a fenced preserve, or a pasture closed to public grazing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a delimited place, particularly one in which grazing is restricted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lexicalized expression equivalent to رُبَّمَا, ‘perhaps’ or ‘it may be that’.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is reported with orthographic uncertainty in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be in a bad state, in perdition, or in error.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expression إِنَّهُ فِي حِيرَ بِيرَ and its variant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much property or many cattle; by extension, a numerous household or family.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural or collective expression for abundance of possessions, livestock, or dependents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to become green with vegetation through the collecting and continued presence of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in a construction describing land that becomes verdant because water accumulates and remains in it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Heerite or made in al-Hirah, especially a sword, camel saddle, or leather saddle ornament.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nisbah adjective referring to manufacture in the town of al-Hirah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For as long as time lasts; indefinitely or for an incalculable period.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed temporal expression with several reported vocalic and orthographic variants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a meadow, full of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective describing a water-filled meadow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for the midday summer sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized poetic or descriptive epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depression or enclosure in which water collects, remains, or circles; a watering-trough or tank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place may have depressed ground and raised edges, retaining water that does not flow out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garden, by extension from a water-retaining enclosure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived place-name or common noun connected with the water-collecting sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grease or oily animal matter flowing from flesh or fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the oily substance released from animal flesh or fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of stars or planets, erratic: appearing at one time to move retrograde and at another to pursue a direct course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized astronomical use describing apparent changes of direction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of clouds, heavy or rain-bearing and remaining without motion, or moving to and fro without being driven onward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to clouds that linger in the sky while raining or shifting without progressing away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way across a desert whose place of exit is unknown.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for a route whose destination or means of egress cannot be identified.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything continuing endlessly or hardly, or never, coming to an end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended adjective for something apparently interminable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A full bowl, especially one containing much grease; also broth containing much grease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fullness expression applied to food containers and greasy broth.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Confusion and loss of direction are covered by the Quranic sense.

cautions: The Quranic root has one supplied occurrence, حَيْرَانَ at 6:71:23; the water, enclosure, astronomical, bodily, and other extensions are broader Classical Arabic evidence.
The reported Form II water-eddy usage is explicitly qualified in the lexical evidence because the cited copy does not confirm it and the passive form may be required.
The expression حَيْرَمَا is reported as equivalent to رُبَّمَا but with orthographic uncertainty.
